name: FreeEntropy.theorem1_achievability
conclusion:
∃ (memory : ℕ → ℕ) (E : (n : ℕ) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin d) (Fin (memory n))) (D :
  (n : ℕ) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin (memory n)) (Fin n → Fin d)),
  Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => Real.logb 2 ↑(memory n) - FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl d r s.eigenvalue n) Filter.atTop
      (nhds 0) ∧
    (fun (n : ℕ) => FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedWorstError s n (E n) (D n)) =O[Filter.atTop]
        FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedWorstError s n (E n) (D n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

name: FreeEntropy.theorem1_converse
conclusion: 0 ≤ Filter.liminf (fun (n : ℕ) => ↑(Real.logb 2 ↑(memory n) - FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl d r s.eigenvalue n)) Filter.atTop

name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.theorem2_cloning_accuracy_choi
conclusion:
FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.prvForward mu nu hmu hnu hinc
        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s mu U))
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s nu U) ≤
    FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d r s.qx * ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.differenceNorm mu nu) /
      (↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.minimumRowGap mu r hd ⋯) + 1) ∧
  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.prvReverse mu nu hmu hnu hinc
        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s nu U))
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s mu U) ≤
    FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d r s.qx * ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.differenceNorm mu nu) /
      (↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.minimumRowGap mu r hd ⋯) + 1)

binders.type: Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)
binders.name: hinc
